parts.label: a
parts.technique: Implicit differentiation, gradient at a point
parts.reason: Requires implicit differentiation to find dy/dx and substitution of a point, covered by P7.5 (differentiate simple functions/relations defined implicitly).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Equation of normal line
parts.reason: Uses gradient conditions for perpendicular lines and equation of a straight line, covered by P3.1; depends on in-spec part (a).

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Integration by parts
parts.reason: Directly covered by P8.5 (integration by parts).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Integration by parts (repeated application)
parts.reason: P8.5 guidance explicitly allows 'more than one application of the method'; uses answer from (a) which is in spec.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Binomial expansion for negative/rational power
parts.reason: Covered by P4.1 (extend binomial expansion to any rational n, including approximation and validity conditions).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Binomial expansion, comparing coefficients
parts.reason: Extension of P4.1 binomial work, comparing coefficients of expansions.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Binomial expansion, comparing coefficients
parts.reason: Same as (b), further coefficient comparison, in spec via P4.1.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Volume of revolution (solid of revolution) using integration
parts.reason: The topic 'volume of revolution (solid formed by rotating a region about an axis)' is explicitly listed as a concept no 9MA0 statement covers, making this out of spec regardless of the integration technique used.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Parametric differentiation to find dy/dx
parts.reason: Covered by P3.3 (parametric equations of curves) combined with P7.5 (differentiate functions defined parametrically).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Finding stationary points from parametric dy/dx=0, solving trig equations
parts.reason: Uses P7.5/P3.3 for parametric differentiation and P5.7 for solving trigonometric equations in a given interval; all methods covered.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Evaluating a function value (trapezium rule table)
parts.reason: Simple evaluation of the given function at a point, part of trapezium rule setup covered by P9.4.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Trapezium rule for numerical integration
parts.reason: Directly covered by P9.4 (use of trapezium rule to estimate area under a curve).

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Integration by substitution
parts.reason: Covered by P8.5 (integration by substitution, includes finding a suitable substitution); trig identity sin2x=2sinxcosx is P5.5/standard.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Definite integration and comparison with trapezium estimate (error)
parts.reason: Uses definite integral evaluation (P8.3) and result from (c), both in spec.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Vector subtraction to find AB from position vectors
parts.reason: Covered by P10.4 (position vectors, distance) and P10.3 (vector algebraic operations); ordinary vector work is in spec.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Vector equation of a line through two points
parts.reason: 'Vector equation of a line (r = a + λb)' is explicitly listed as a concept no 9MA0 statement covers, so this part is out of spec.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Angle between two vectors using scalar (dot) product
parts.reason: 'Scalar (dot) product, including the angle between vectors or lines' is explicitly listed as excluded/not covered by any statement.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Finding position vector of fourth vertex of parallelogram
parts.reason: Directly matches P10.5 guidance example (finding position vector of fourth corner of parallelogram given three position vectors), using vector addition (P10.3) and does not depend on out-of-spec parts (b) or (c).

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Area of parallelogram using (1/2)|AB||AD|sinθ with angle from dot product
parts.reason: Mark scheme requires the angle found in part (c) via dot product; this uses the out-of-spec dot-product/angle result, and no alternative in-spec method (e.g. cross product) is offered—cross product is also excluded—so this part is out.

parts.label: f
parts.technique: Shortest distance from point to line using trigonometry with angle from part (c)
parts.reason: Depends directly on the out-of-spec angle found via dot product in part (c); the part only makes sense after that out-of-spec result.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Partial fractions decomposition
parts.reason: Covered by P2.10 (decompose rational functions into partial fractions, denominators not more complicated than squared linear terms).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Solving separable first order differential equation using partial fractions and integration, forming general solution
parts.reason: Covered by P8.7 (analytical solution of separable first order differential equations, including finding particular solutions) combined with P8.6 (integration using partial fractions) and P6.3/P6.4 (logarithm laws).

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Interpreting solution of differential equation for limiting behaviour
parts.reason: Covered by P8.8 (interpret the solution of a differential equation in context, including identifying limitations of the solution, considering behaviour for large t).
